c.title: $6,200 / 2br - 1380ft2 - Beautiful Kits Point Townhome - 2 Bed & 2 Bath (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Welcome to this inviting multi-level townhome in the highly sought-after Kits Point neighbourhood. Ideally situated just moments from Kitsilano Beach and the shops, cafés, and restaurants along West 4th Avenue, this home offers the best of Vancouver’s West Side lifestyle.

Offering 1,380 sq. ft. of interior living space, this thoughtfully laid-out home features two bedrooms, a dedicated office/flex area, and multiple outdoor spaces, including a private rooftop patio — perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, or relaxing in the sunshine.

Property Features
-1,380 sq. ft. of interior living space
-Two bedrooms plus a separate office/flex area
-Multi-level layout offering separation between living and sleeping areas
-Spacious living and dining areas
-Functional kitchen with ample workspace
-Private rooftop patio
-Additional patios and balcony
-Two bathrooms, including a main-floor powder room
-Excellent layout for professionals, couples, or a small family
-One covered parking spot
-Unbeatable Kits Point Location

Enjoy coastal living in one of Vancouver’s most desirable neighbourhoods. Take a short stroll to Kitsilano Beach and the waterfront, explore the local parks and cycling routes, or enjoy the cafés, restaurants, and boutique shopping along West 4th Avenue. With convenient access to Granville Island, downtown Vancouver, and transit, this location offers the perfect balance of neighbourhood charm and city convenience.

Rental Terms
-Minimum one-year lease
-Credit and reference checks required
-No pets
-Tenant insurance required

A wonderful opportunity to enjoy spacious living, multiple outdoor retreats, and an exceptional beachside location in the heart of Kits Point. Contact by replying to this ad to book a showing.
